papers.title: Beam-Wise Statistical Background Subtraction for Static Roadside LiDAR: A Cross-Sensor Benchmark Study
papers.authors: Alexander Baumann, Marcel Vosshans, Thao Dang
papers.tags: LiDAR, autonomous driving, BEV perception, scene understanding, object detection
papers.affiliations: University of Applied Sciences Esslingen, Germany（埃斯林根应用科学大学，德国）
papers.intro: 本文提出了光束级统计背景减除方法，通过将背景估计建模为逐光束的时间序列问题，结合空间一致性滤波，在跨多种LiDAR传感器技术的多个场景中实现了鲁棒且可迁移的静态背景建模，并发布了新的多LiDAR数据集HighwayScene和扩展的CoopScenes静态/动态标注。

papers.title: Qwen-Video-Edit: Instruction-Based Video Editing by Repurposing an Image Editing Model
papers.authors: Yunpeng Bai, Yossi Gandelsman, Michaël Gharbi, Qixing Huang
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: UT Austin（Yunpeng Bai, Qixing Huang）；Reve（Yossi Gandelsman, Michaël Gharbi）
papers.intro: 本文通过将视频VAE潜在帧视为虚拟图像网格的瓦片，仅用两个轻量级投影层桥接图像与视频潜在空间，即可将成熟的Qwen-Image-Edit图像编辑模型直接转化为视频编辑模型，无需视频预训练骨干。

papers.title: MegaParts: Scaling Part-Aware 3D Object Generation to 300 Parts via Token-Efficient Autoregressive Modeling
papers.authors: Manwen Liao, Xinyu Lian, Jian Mao, Kaixu Chen, Li Luo, Jinghao Yan, Wanshui Gan, Qiao Yu, Weitian Zhang, Chunhua Shen, Guang Chen, Bo Dai, Xudong Xu, Zhaoyang Lyu
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, image generation, diffusion model, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: The University of Hong Kong, Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Fudan University, Tongji University, University of Science and Technology of China, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Zhejiang University, Shanghai Innovation Institute
papers.intro: MegaParts提出了一种基于token高效自回归建模的可扩展部分感知3D生成框架，通过自适应长度的离散部件表示和统一结构化序列生成，将部分感知3D生成扩展到多达300个部件和256k token的规模，同时提升了几何生成质量。

papers.title: CPI-Bench: A Comprehensive, Practical and Intelligent Benchmark for Real-World Image Editing
papers.authors: Qinye Zhou, Jun Zheng, Yongchao Du, Yuan Wang, Zhengrui Chen, Zuan Gao, Taihang Hu, Chao Lin, Yefeng Shen, Xingjian Wang, Zhao Wang, Zhengtao Wu, Xiaoli Xu, Zhengze Xu, Hao Yan, Denghui Yang, Yuhang Yu, Huayu Zhang, Mingzhou Zhang, Mengting Chen
papers.tags: image generation, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Alibaba Group
papers.intro: CPI-Bench是一个面向真实世界图像编辑的综合性、实用性和智能性基准，通过三个递进难度的子集（General、Practical、Intelligent）全面评测模型的通用编辑能力、实际部署效能和高级推理编辑能力，并与Arena人类偏好排名达到最高一致性。

papers.title: MagnifiQ: Patch-aware Text Guided Progressive Upscaling for High-Resolution Image Restoration
papers.authors: Mahesh Reddy, Yashesh Savani, Antoine Mercier, Hong Cai, Fatih Porikli, Guillaume Berger
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Qualcomm AI Research
papers.intro: MagnifiQ提出了一种基于预训练SDXL扩散模型的渐进式超分辨率图像恢复框架，通过将自注意力替换为线性复杂度的PADRe卷积块、采用多阶段渐进放大策略以及引入patch级文本提示的Patch-Aware Cross-Attention（PACA）机制，实现了最高32倍放大、支持4K分辨率的图像恢…

papers.title: Style or Signature? Artist-Disjoint Evaluation of Style Classification in Frozen Vision Embeddings
papers.authors: Rory Ashton
papers.tags: image classification, CLIP, vision transformer, image retrieval
papers.affiliations: University of Edinburgh
papers.intro: 论文提出了一种艺术家不相交（leave-one-artist-out）的评估协议，用于重新评估冻结视觉嵌入中的绘画风格分类，发现标准随机划分评估高估了风格理解能力，实际准确率从0.87降至0.77，且下降在不同艺术运动中极不均匀，表明部分风格分类成功实际上依赖于艺术家身份识别。

papers.title: Designing Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Models: A Unified Path-Space View
papers.authors: Yixian Xu, Yuanrui Zhang, Shengjie Luo, Liwei Wang, Di He
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: 北京大学（State Key Laboratory of General Artificial Intelligence, School of Intelligence Science and Technology, Peking University）；字节跳动（ByteDance Seed）
papers.intro: 本文从路径空间视角出发，通过路径空间重要性采样和方差缩减定理，将Flow-GRPO、AWM、DiffusionNFT等看似不同的扩散RL算法统一到一个通用模板中，并据此提出多样本KDE值梯度估计器和尺度有界权重族，在SD3.5-M和Qwen-Image模型上验证了方差缩减解释并超越了现有基线。

papers.title: GhostPoint: Self-Supervised Representation Learning by Hallucinating Occluded LiDAR Structure
papers.authors: Mohamed Abdelsamad, Bin Yang, Michael Ulrich, Miao Zhang, Yakov Miron, Alexandru Paul Condurache, Abhinav Valada
papers.tags: point cloud, 3D reconstruction, autonomous driving, LiDAR
papers.affiliations: Bosch Center for AI, University of Freiburg, University of Luebeck
papers.intro: GhostPoint提出了一种自监督学习框架，通过在发现实例周围的局部邻域中幻觉化潜在特征（包括未观测区域），显式建模超出可见LiDAR回波的结构，从而弥合SSL预训练与3D目标检测之间的表示差距。

papers.title: IRGNN: Efficient Invariant Radar Graph Neural Network for Radar Point Cloud Object Detection
papers.authors: Xiao Guo, Wanke Xia, Lili Yang, Caicong Wu
papers.tags: object detection, point cloud, autonomous driving, BEV perception, LiDAR
papers.affiliations: China Agricultural University; Tsinghua University
papers.intro: 本文提出IRGNN，一种基于平移和旋转不变图表示及改进消息传递神经网络的雷达点云目标检测框架，在RadarScenes数据集上取得了优于现有雷达检测方法的性能，同时显著降低了推理计算成本和内存占用。

papers.title: VLM- and LLM-Driven Multi-Agent System for PET Image Denoising
papers.authors: Boxiao Yu, Savas Ozdemir, Yang Xing, Fumio Hashimoto, Jiong Wu, Yizhou Chen, Axel Rominger, Ruogu Fang, Kuangyu Shi, Tinsu Pan, Kuang Gong
papers.tags: diffusion model, medical image, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: University of Florida, University of Florida Jacksonville, University of Bern, University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center
papers.intro: 本文提出一种由视觉-语言模型（VLM）和大语言模型（LLM）驱动的多智能体闭环框架，通过感知、调度、执行和反馈四个阶段实现低剂量PET图像的自适应去噪，动态评估图像质量和病灶状态，自主选择最优去噪模型和参数，并支持带回滚机制的闭环反馈。

papers.title: ChartProbe: A Diagnostic Study on Visual Reasoning through Perception, Grounding, and Simple Reasoning
papers.authors: Mahsa Khoshnoodi, Sarah Adel Bargal
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, image captioning
papers.affiliations: Department of Computer Science, Georgetown University
papers.intro: ChartProbe通过从图表渲染代码直接生成精确的技能定向探针，将图表视觉问答分解为感知、定位绑定和简单推理三个原子技能，并证明仅监督这些简单技能（不包含任何复杂推理数据）就能显著提升模型在未见过的复杂推理问题上的表现。

papers.title: Limitations of Synthetic Data Generation in Specialized Data-Scarce Domains
papers.authors: Edward Zhang, Marcel Hussing, Tanay Tandon, Shenbagaraj Kannapiran, Jason Hughes, Youkang Wang, Joshua Caswell, Agelos Kratimenos, Yi Fan Li, Milan Manoj, Ethan Sanchez, Sumukh Shrote, Camillo Jose Taylor, Daniel A. Hashimoto, Eric Eaton
papers.tags: image classification, image generation, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: University of Pennsylvania, Philadelphia, PA, USA; The Hong Kong Polytechnic University (PolyU), Hung Hom, Hong Kong
papers.intro: 本文通过系统对比非生成式与生成式数据增强方法在五个创伤分类任务上的表现，发现扩散模型生成的合成数据在稀疏、高方差领域无法一致超越强非生成式基线，并揭示了记忆/坍缩、分布漂移和生成"简化典型实例"三种失败模式。

papers.title: TRUE-Colon: Exposing a Consistent Transfer Asymmetry in Real-Time Polyp Detection
papers.authors: Sebastian Doerrich, Andreas Franz Schwab, Francesco Di Salvo, Shyam Nandan Rai, Hanh Huyen My Nguyen, Christian Ledig
papers.tags: object detection, medical image, video segmentation, YOLO, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: xAILab Bamberg, University of Bamberg, Bamberg, Germany
papers.intro: 本文建立了一个标准化的部署相关评估协议TRUE-Colon，通过对比四种实时目标检测器在精选基准（SUN、PICCOLO）与60个完整未剪辑结肠镜视频（REAL-Colon）上的表现，揭示了"精选训练→完整流程评估"性能崩溃而"完整流程训练→精选基准评估"性能保持的持续迁移不对称性，证明完整流程数据…

papers.title: MedPlex: Deep Vision-Language Co-Adaptation for Clinically Grounded Medical Segmentation
papers.authors: Rafi Ibn Sultan, Hui Zhu, Chengyin Li, Dongxiao Zhu
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, medical image, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Wayne State University; Henry Ford Health
papers.intro: MedPlex提出了一种端到端的视觉-语言协同适应框架，通过双向融合和概念级对齐机制，使文本指导成为医学图像分割学习中持续、临床可解释的组成部分，在CT和MR多器官、心脏亚结构和肿瘤分割基准上达到最先进性能。

papers.title: PROVE: Training-Free Prompt Recovery using Verifiable Evidence
papers.authors: Rupayan Mallick, Mahsa Khoshnoodi, Sarah Adel Bargal
papers.tags: image generation, CLIP
papers.affiliations: Department of Computer Science, Georgetown University
papers.intro: PROVE提出了一种无需训练、黑盒的提示反演攻击方法，通过组合可验证的场景描述而非优化令牌序列来重构提示，每个恢复的声明都基于明确的图像证据，并通过精度约束的召回最大化目标进行形式化。

papers.title: What to Preserve, Where to Adapt: A Depth-Wise Analysis of Forgetting in Continual Gynecological Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Amal Saqib, Tausifa Jan Saleem, Numan Saeed, Mohammad Yaqub
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, medical image
papers.affiliations: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI), Abu Dhabi, UAE
papers.intro: 本文通过块级消融分析和深度受限适应实验，系统揭示了在持续妇科图像分割中，编码器-解码器网络的早期编码器和晚期解码器区域对分割性能最为关键，而将参数更新限制在瓶颈附近区域时遗忘有限，一旦更新扩展到浅层编码器和解码器则遗忘急剧增加。

papers.title: AutoDesign: Meta-Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Design
papers.authors: Yaxin Luo, Haobin Jiang, Jialv Zou, Xu Huang, Wenhao Yan, Haodong Li, Zhengrong Yue, Jing Li, Xiaofu Chen, Xiaohan Zhao, Jiacheng Liu, Jiacheng Cui, Zhiqiang Shen, Xiaotong Li
papers.tags: image generation, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Meituan, MBZUAI, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Peking University, Tsinghua University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
papers.intro: AutoDesign提出了一种元框架优化（meta-harness optimization）框架，通过外层循环递归优化设计框架（design harness）本身而非单个工件，使静态设计框架转变为可递归自我改进的、人类对齐的多模态设计系统，在论文到海报生成任务上显著超越现有商业系统。

papers.title: V-RAE: Rethinking Video Latent Spaces for Generation
papers.authors: Minghui Guo, Shengqiong Wu, Hao Fei
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, video segmentation
papers.affiliations: National University of Singapore, University of Oxford
papers.intro: V-RAE提出了一种视频表示自编码器，利用冻结的视觉基础模型特征作为生成潜空间，通过轻量级时间池化和时空Transformer解码器实现紧凑、语义丰富且时间连贯的视频潜表示，在重建、生成和预测任务上均优于传统视频VAE。

papers.title: HumanTracker: Towards Comprehensive and Human-Aligned Motion Tracking Benchmark
papers.authors: Dairu Liu, Zekun Qi, Jiayu Zeng, Ruixi Yu, Yu Guan, Yintianrun Zhang, Xuchuan Chen, Sikai Liang, Zekai Li, Chenghuai Lin, Xinqiang Yu, Wenyao Zhang, He Wang, Li Yi
papers.tags: pose estimation, tracking, video segmentation, autonomous driving, 3D reconstruction
papers.affiliations: Nankai University, Tsinghua University, Galbot, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Peking University, Shanghai Qi Zhi Institute
papers.intro: 本文提出HumanTracker基准（约153小时、25K片段的光学运动轨迹）和HumanScore偏好对齐评估指标，通过人类偏好数据训练的奖励模型来更准确地评估人形机器人运动跟踪质量，弥补传统运动学指标的不足。

papers.title: EgoMonth: A Month-Level Egocentric Video Benchmark for Long-Term Spatiotemporal Memory
papers.authors: Weitao Chen, Hu Jiaxin, Xie Tianyidan, Yang Li, Yuyi Qian, Banghao Xu, Ziheng Tang, Shenyi Wang, Mingyue Yu, Duo Li, Jiacheng Shi, Gao Wang, Zhan Xu, Zhicheng Qiu, Xuanfu Li, Jian Yang, Lanjun Wang, Zili Yi
papers.tags: video search
papers.affiliations: 南京大学（Nanjing University）、华为技术有限公司（Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd.）、天津大学（Tianjin University）
papers.intro: EgoMonth 是首个月级别的第一视角视频理解基准，包含 300+ 小时真实日常生活录像和 1,443 个多选问答对，通过 14 个任务的三层认知框架揭示了当前 MLLMs 在长期时空记忆上远逊于人类，本质上是“有损摘要器”而非“忠实记忆器”。
